description: This file defines the Command class within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing an AWS command object with methods for managing command data, handler lists, authentication schemes, and metrics.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents an AWS SDK command with properties for command name, arguments, handler list, auth schemes, and metrics, including methods for configuration and retrieval of these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Command instance with provided name, arguments, handler list, and metrics builder, setting default values for HTTP and context data.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the command, including cloning the handler list.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the command.

methods.name: hasParam
methods.description: Checks if a parameter with the given name exists in the command's data.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Retrieves the handler list associated with this command.

methods.name: setAuthSchemes
methods.description: Sets authentication schemes for the command; this method is deprecated and triggers a user warning.

methods.name: getAuthSchemes
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication schemes configured for the command; this method is deprecated and triggers a user warning.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Deprecated method to access parameters by name, delegating to array access.

methods.name: getMetricsBuilder
methods.description: Returns the metrics builder object associated with this command.
